the use of a specific type of translation activity (the translation of mathematical statements from one language to another) is a useful way to help students to improve their capacities for mathematical translation.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the capacities of translation are improved when students are engaged in a process of learning statistics that includes: • a variety of representations of statistical concepts; • opportunities for students to engage with these representations in a variety of contexts; • opportunities for reflection on the nature of the concepts; and • opportunities for students and teachers to communicate with each other about the concepts.
